title: OTHRYS OS intervention policy and gate visibility
goal: Expose operator intervention policy and distinguish human approval from independent evidence in the OS Work surface without adding transition authority.
laws: Intervention policy is presentation and operator preference only.
Human approval and independent evidence remain separate gates.
Policy selection never grants execution, transition, accept, reject or release authority.
Default policy is checkpoint-oriented and conservative.
Preference persists locally on the controller only.
Trust Canal remains the authority boundary.
No new write API is added.
